_comment: The results specification's domain vocabulary (0.4): what an analysis is about, the signal or tissue property, so a gallery can group analyses. Each domain names the modalities that use it. An analysis may give a domain not here (the checker warns) -- add it here, in Lumière, with a CHANGELOG line.

aperiodic.description: the aperiodic (1/f) part of the power spectrum

evoked.description: responses time-locked to stimuli: ERPs, ITC, ERSP

connectivity.description: undirected coupling between regions or channels, and the networks it forms

cross_frequency.description: coupling between rhythms: PAC, AAC, n:m phase coupling

directed.description: directed influence between regions: transfer entropy, DTF

decoding.description: classifying groups or conditions from the data

localization.description: how well sources are localized: registration, coverage, settings

microstructure.description: tissue microstructure: diffusion and myelin-water measures

morphometry.description: size and shape: volumes, densities, Jacobians

function.description: resting or task BOLD activity: ReHo, ALFF, fALFF
